caption: The drawing depicts a necklace composed of small, irregularly shaped red beads strung together in two interconnected loops. At the upper end of the necklace, there is a small, dark metallic hook or clasp. At the lower end, where the two loops converge, there is a metallic cross pendant with a rounded bead above it. The cross is silver or gray in color, featuring three small dots in its vertical section, slightly raised edges, and small extensions at the ends of each arm. The beads vary in size and shape, and the necklace lies on a plain, off-white or beige background. There are no additional objects or elements in the image. In the lower right corner, there is a small, handwritten inscription that reads: "MIGUEL G. GUISLIN - TAOS."
title: Coral Beads and Crucifix
